title: Ring pulse runs ~16x slower than the art-direction §6.1 escalation rates the code comments claim (amber 0.078 Hz, red 0.156 Hz, not 1.25/2.5 Hz)
detail: Epic-4-context constraint: 'the ring pulse rate is itself the escalation signal: slow ~1.2 Hz strained, fast ~2.5 Hz critical'. idx advances 1 table entry per `step` ticks: amber 16×16=256 ticks=12.8 s (0.078 Hz), red 16×8=128 ticks=6.4 s (0.156 Hz) — ~16x slower than the rates the code's own comments (and §6.1) state; 1.25 Hz needs step=1, 2.5 Hz needs 2 entries/tick.
recommended_fix: Advance the phase per tick at the documented rates (amber 1 table step/tick = 16-tick cycle; red 2 steps/tick = 8-tick cycle) — e.g. idx := ((tick + node_id*5) * u64(step)) & 15 with steps 1/2 — and correct the comments.

title: Run HUD still instructs 'deliver a packet to win' in the 4.1 sandbox where win/lose is disabled (goal 0) — the promised win never fires
detail: The 4.1 session config (goal 0 / cap 0, per spec: 'start_run sets state.era = 3 + goal 0 / cap 0 (win/lose disabled)') means win_lose_eval can never fire, yet the Run HUD unconditionally promises 'deliver a packet to win' — the score readout was made goal-conditional but this line was not.
recommended_fix: Conditionalize the instruction on app.state.goal > 0 (like the score readout at main.odin:535) or reword it for the era-3 sandbox (e.g. 'oversubscribe to watch the strain telegraph').
